items.q: How can I book an apartment?
items.a: You can book on www.zencentralapartments.com or by phone at +36 30 116 9431.

items.q: Do I need to pay a deposit?
items.a: Yes, the deposit is 50% of the total amount. For bookings made through certain partner sites the full amount is payable in advance.

items.q: How can I cancel my booking?
items.a:
For direct bookings (website, e-mail) cancellation is free of charge up to 15 days before arrival and the amount paid is refunded.
For cancellations within 15 days we charge 50% of the accommodation fee, in case of no-show 100% as a penalty. Please send your cancellation by e-mail: zencentralapartments@gmail.com

The apartment is available from 2:00 pm and we kindly ask you to leave by 10:00 am on the day of departure. Earlier check-in or later check-out is possible by prior arrangement, depending on availability, for a surcharge.

items.q: We arrive very late – how do we get in?
items.a: Check-in is self-service with a key safe, so arriving late is no problem.

items.q: When do I have to pay?
items.a: The remaining amount after the deposit is payable on arrival.

items.q: Which payment methods do you accept?
items.a:
• Cash or bank transfer (for direct bookings)
  • Bank card (MasterCard, Maestro, VISA, VISA Electron) – only online, for bookings on the website or partner sites
  • SZÉP card is currently not accepted

items.q: Do the prices include VAT and tourist tax?
items.a: Prices include VAT but not the tourist tax. The tourist tax is HUF 500 / person / night (over 18).

items.q: What is included in the price?
items.a:
The price includes accommodation without meals, plus:

  • free WiFi throughout the apartment
  • free parking in the courtyard or in front of the house
  • VAT
  • basic household and hygiene supplies

items.q: Is there internet in the apartment?
items.a: Yes, fast wireless internet is available throughout the building.

items.q: Can we cook in the apartment?
items.a: Yes, every apartment has a well-equipped kitchen – cutlery, dishes, glasses, kettle, fridge, coffee maker, induction hob and microwave are provided.

items.q: Do we need to bring everyday items?
items.a: No. Towels, bed linen, cutlery, glasses, hairdryer, toilet paper, hand sanitiser and hangers are provided.
Yes, our apartments can be booked all year round and have modern heating.
Although we love animals, we cannot accommodate pets in our apartments.
The apartments are non-smoking. Smoking is only allowed in the designated area, in the courtyard or on the shared terrace.
Each apartment has 1 private parking space. For more cars please contact us in advance; free street parking is also available.

items.q: Where exactly is ZEN Central Apartments?
items.a: Address: 8200 Veszprém, Festő street 6. The city centre is a few minutes' walk away; the neighbourhood is quiet and safe – ideal for relaxing and sightseeing.

data.title: ZEN Central apartments
data.html: Our newly built, modern accommodation, ZEN Central Apartments, is located on the upper floor of a garden house in the heart of downtown Veszprém. It consists of 3 apartments: RELAX Studio for 2 guests, LOTUS Studio for 3 guests, and JIN JANG, a 2-bedroom apartment for up to 4 guests. Each apartment is air-conditioned and equipped with a well-appointed kitchen, a shower bathroom, and complimentary enclosed courtyard parking.
